Package edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D

Class PointSet3D

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Item3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.PointSet3D
public class PointSet3D extends Item3D
A set of same-color, same-size points, drawn as either square or circular point sprites.

  • Constructor Details

    • PointSet3D

      public PointSet3D(Panel3D panel3D, float[] coords, Color color, float pointSize, boolean circular)
      Create a set of same color and size points for use on a Panel3D.
      Parameters:
      panel3D - the owner 3D panel
      coords - the points as [x1, y1, z1, ..., xn, yn, zn]
      color - the color of the points
      pointSize - the drawing size of the points
      circular - if true, draw round point sprites; if false, square
